title: Claude Code — Team
description: Compare Claude Code usage and cost across developers.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) != '' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per user
panels.description: Totals for the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT u AS user, cost_usd, tokens, sessions, active_hours, lines_added, commits, pull_requests FROM (SELECT if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) AS u, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage') AS cost_usd, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage') AS tokens, uniqExactIf(Attributes['session.id'], Attributes['session.id'] != '') AS sessions, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total') / 3600 AS active_hours, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND Attributes['type'] = 'added') AS lines_added, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.commit.count') AS commits, sumIf(Value, MetricName = 'claude_code.pull_request.count') AS pull_requests FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND MetricName LIKE 'claude_code.%' GROUP BY u) WHERE u != '' AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR user = '${user}') ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) AS user, sum(Value) AS cost FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY time, user ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) AS user, sum(Value) AS seconds FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY time, user ORDER BY time

SELECT if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) AS user, uniqExact(SessionId) AS sessions FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(UserEmail != '', UserEmail, UserId) = '${user}') AND SessionId != '' GROUP BY user ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) AS user, sum(Value) AS tokens FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND AggregationTemporality = 1 AND ServiceName IN ('claude-code', 'claude-code-desktop') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ('${user}' = '__all__' OR if(Attributes['user.email'] != '', Attributes['user.email'], if(ResourceAttributes['user.email'] != '', ResourceAttributes['user.email'], Attributes['user.id'])) = '${user}') GROUP BY user ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20
